script: My boyfriend, the ultimate cool guy, just blushed—here's how I made it happen.. I was in the kitchen, flipping kabobs, when my boyfriend walked in. He'd just finished helping his mom, so he was all calm and cool—like the whole "no blush" vibe. I'd been telling myself I'd finally cracked him. He grabbed my face, kissed me, hugged me. I told him how cute he looked, and he walked away, cheeks turning a soft, ridiculous pink. I felt that win, like I'd just pulled a rabbit out of a hat. He's been dating me for almost four years, and he's never been the type to blush. I've got this gamer couple, and every time I cook for him he thanks me with a kiss. Today, I made his kabobs. He was so calm, like a Zen master. Then I said, "You're so cute," and boom—his cheeks? Lit. I am literally thrilled, bestie. I just made my boyfriend blush. That's the tea.
